package.name: RTX Remix for Garry's Mod
package.title: RTX Remix for Garry's Mod (native loader package)
package.description: Native package for the GMod native loader: the RTX Remix runtime and the RTX fixes. It needs the loader (bin\win64\winmm.dll) and a native-loader\config.json that allowlists this item. GMod does not mount this item itself; the loader deploys it.
